payload.title: Reader islands: sign-in, vote, rating, used-it, freshness
payload.description:
As a reader, I want small accessible controls on the page so that I can sign in, vote and rate.

Feature: Islands
  Scenario: Reader sign-in is not open yet
    Given the API answers 503 reader_identity_unavailable
    Then the controls show 'Reader sign-in is not open yet' and are disabled
  Scenario: Keyboard
    Then vote and rating are buttons with aria-pressed and text states
